summary: FILING: Shinhan Financial Group Co., Ltd. files Form 6-K to disclose a routine shareholding change by its largest shareholder, Korea's National Pension Service (NPS). TERMS: NPS's common shares increased from 42,575,588 (8.97% as of April 30, 2026) to 43,630,195 (9.19% as of June 30, 2026). BOARD RECOMMENDATION / ADVISOR: Not applicable. MECHANICS & STRUCTURE: This is a periodic ownership disclosure based on the shareholder registry closing as of June 30, 2026; no transaction, offer, or corporate action is involved. WHAT TO WATCH / RISK-ARB ANGLE: This is a non-event regulatory filing; no special situation or actionable catalyst.
